name: Crocodile Trip In Goa
description:
Explore the different facet of Goa, by taking a trip in the backwaters of the Cambarjua Canal. Here, you will not only see crocodiles but a diverse variety of birds which you wouldn’t see easily along the seaside. It is considered as a perfect family outing. Any nature lover would fall in love with this side of Goa. Departure and Location:
The trip is of two and a half hours beginning at 9:00 am, the meeting point being Old Goa Jetty so as to be transported to Cortalim jetty in the South via boat. The South pick-up is scheduled at 10:00 am. The boat will take you upwards through the Zuari River to Cumbarjua Canal.

details.title: Time of the Activity::
details.content: 1st Trip 9:00am, 2nd Trip 12:00pm, 3rd Trip 02:00pm & 4th Trip 04:00pm

details.title: Zuari River:
details.content: Zuari River, being 92 kilometers long is considered as the largest river in the state of Goa. The river originates at Hemad-Barshem in the Western Ghats and flows through the Talukas of Tiswadi, Ponda, Marmagoa, Salcette, Sanguem and Quepem in the south-west direction.

details.title: Cumbarjua Canal:
details.content: The Cumbarjua Canal connects the Zuari River along with the Mandovi River. You will see the fisherman doing various activities as you cruise down the canal.

details.title: Mangroves Sighting:
details.content: You will find a line of Mangroves on the banks of the Cambarjua Canal. This area is considered to be the home for variety of fish, mollusk and crabs. The mangroves helps in the prevention of soil erosion and makes sure that the land is protected from tidal surges. The wood of mangroves is ideal for fuel and the buildings, thereby, not prone to rotting.

details.title: Crocodile Safari:
details.content: The Cambarjua canal is considered as the main crocodile station in Goa. The mugger crocodile which is a broad-snouted marsh crocodile and can grow as large as 4-5 meters in length has its home in Cambarjua. The males are heavier than females. They are skilled predators but they are not known to attack humans. The third membrane in their eyes enables them to see things and keep water out of their sight. Holes are dug by female crocodiles to lay eggs and the temperature of the nest determines the sex of the crocodile. If the temperature is around 32.5 Celsius then the crocodile will be a male and it will be a female if the temperature is between 28-31 Celsius.

details.title: Bird Watching Safari:
details.content: The scenery of the backwaters is made even more beautiful with the different kinds of birds that you will spot. It is a two-hour trip. The various birds are the white-breasted kingfisher, the drongo, the pied kingfisher, pariah kites, the sandpiper, kingfisher being black-capped, egrets, cormorants, terns and so on.

name: Dudh sagar waterfall
description: Dudhsagar Waterfall, meaning “Sea of Milk”, is one of India’s tallest and most breathtaking waterfalls, located on the Goa–Karnataka border inside the Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary. Cascading from a height of 1017 feet, this four-tiered marvel creates a spectacular sight, especially during the monsoon, when it roars in full glory.

name: Goa Hampi Tour
description: A Goa-Hampi tour combines the coastal beauty of Goa with the historical and architectural wonders of Hampi. This type of tour offers a unique experience, allowing you to explore two distinct destinations in one trip. Here's what you can expect from a Goa-Hampi tour:
features: Pickup and Drop from airport or Railway station

details.title: Beaches
details.content: Start your tour with Goa's beautiful beaches, such as Baga, Calangute, Anjuna, and Palolem. Enjoy water sports, sunbathing, or simply relaxing on the sand.

details.title: Cultural and Historical Sites
details.content: Visit iconic landmarks like the Basilica of Bom Jesus, Se Cathedral, and Aguada Fort to learn about Goa's rich history and culture.

details.title: Water Sports and Adventure:
details.content: Try activities like parasailing, jet skiing, and snorkeling for an adventurous experience.

details.title: Nightlife:
details.content: Explore Goa's vibrant nightlife with its many clubs, beach parties, and bars.

details.title: Local Cuisine
details.content: Taste Goan cuisine, including seafood dishes like prawn curry, fish thali, and vindaloo.

details.title: Travel to Hampi
details.content: The journey from Goa to Hampi is around 8 to 9 hours by road. Alternatively, you can take a train from Goa to Hospet, which is the nearest major railway station to Hampi, and then drive about 13 km to Hampi.

details.title: Historical and Architectural Wonders
details.content: Hampi is a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its incredible ruins and temples. Visit landmarks such as the Virupaksha Temple, Vittala Temple, and the stone chariot.

details.title: Boulders and Landscapes:
details.content: Hampi is known for its stunning boulder-strewn landscapes. Explore the boulders and unique rock formations around the region.

details.title: Riverboat Rides:
details.content: Take a coracle ride on the Tungabhadra River, providing a peaceful and scenic experience.

details.title: Local Markets
details.content: Discover local arts and crafts at Hampi's markets, such as stone carvings, jewelry, and textiles.

name: Goa murudeshwar
description: A Goa-Gokarna Murudeshwar tour combines the beaches and vibrant culture of Goa with the spiritual and natural beauty of Gokarna and Murudeshwar. These destinations are located along the Karnataka coast, making it easy to visit all three in one trip. Here's what you can expect from a Goa-Gokarna Murudeshwar tour:
features: Pickup and Drop from airport or Railway station

details.title: Beaches
details.content: Begin your tour by exploring Goa's stunning beaches, such as Baga, Calangute, Anjuna, and Palolem. Enjoy water sports, sunbathing, and beach activities.

details.title: Cultural and Historical Sites:
details.content: Visit landmarks like the Basilica of Bom Jesus, Se Cathedral, and Aguada Fort to learn about Goa's rich history and culture.

details.title: Water Sports and Adventure:
details.content: Try activities like parasailing, jet skiing, and snorkeling for an adventurous experience.

details.title: Nightlife:
details.content: Explore Goa's vibrant nightlife with its many clubs, beach parties, and bars.

details.title: Local Cuisine:
details.content: Taste Goan cuisine, including seafood dishes like prawn curry, fish thali, and vindaloo.

details.title: Travel to Gokarna:
details.content: Gokarna is located about 150 km south of Goa, and you can travel by car, bus, or train. The journey takes around 3 to 4 hours by road.

details.title: Beaches:
details.content: Gokarna is known for its pristine and less crowded beaches, such as Om Beach, Kudle Beach, Half Moon Beach, and Paradise Beach.

details.title: Spiritual Sites:
details.content: Visit the Mahabaleshwar Temple, one of the most important Shiva temples in India. The town has a spiritual and peaceful atmosphere, making it a great place to relax and reflect.

details.title: Local Markets:
details.content: Explore Gokarna's local markets for souvenirs, clothing, and local handicrafts.

name: Houseboat
description:
Goa is famous for its pristine and serene blue waters and glorious yet mesmerizing sunsets. To enhance your Goa trip with everlasting memories go for an overnight stay in a houseboat cruise at Mandovi River so as to enrich your vacation experience. The Mandovi River is considered as the lifeline of Goa. This Luxury Premium overnight cruise begins near Britona Jetty in Panjim. From Britona you sail from the Mandovi River to reach the Zuari River. Then head back towards Britona.

Explore the hidden gems of Goa in the luxurious and spacious houseboat cruise and get awestruck with the breathtaking and never seen the beauty of nature. This is the most pleasant river cruise than the adrenalin adventure which puts your life at risk.
